metadataReview.note: The Neue Deutsche Biographie states that Focko Ukena defeated the noble army brought by Archbishop Nikolaus of Bremen 'bei Detern'. The locator is the gazetteer point for the village of Detern, used as a sector reference; the Ostfriesische Landschaft describes Detern as a scattered settlement, and no fetched source fixes the field of battle. Both fetched non-gazetteer sources date the battle 26 September 1426 (the NDB text and the title of the novella listed in the Ostfriesische Landschaft bibliography), against the catalogue's and Wikidata's 27 September; because the sources disagree, the existing date is retained and the one-day discrepancy is flagged for a date review. Strengths, losses and equipment are not inferred.

metadataReview.coordinateBasis: GeoNames 2937944 (Detern, feature code P.PPLA4) publishes latitude 53.21144 and longitude 7.66269, rounded to [7.6627,53.2114]. OpenStreetMap place node 240088890 (Detern, place=village, wikidata Q559632) lies about 0.5 km east at 53.2109195, 7.6700309, corroborating the named place. Independently of the gazetteers, the Ostfriesische Landschaft places Detern about 1.5 km east of Stickhausen and just under 14 km east of Leer; the GeoNames point is about 1.3 km east of the OSM Stickhausen village node and about 13.9 km east of the OSM Leer boundary centre. This is a village reference for an engagement documented only as 'bei Detern'; it is not a surveyed battlefield, a troop position or the centre of the fighting. No accuracy radius is claimed.
